scripts.build:core: cd .. && wasm-pack build core --target web --out-dir app/src/core && cp core/app/src/core/worldgen_core.js core/app/src/core/worldgen_core.d.ts core/app/src/core/worldgen_core_bg.wasm core/app/src/core/worldgen_core_bg.wasm.d.ts app/src/core/ && rm -rf core/app/src/core
scripts.verify:edit-node: cd .. && wasm-pack build core --target nodejs --out-dir /tmp/world_node && cd app && node scripts/verify_heightmap_edit_node.mjs
scripts.verify:pick-reset-node: cd .. && wasm-pack build core --target nodejs --out-dir /tmp/world_node && cd app && node scripts/verify_pick_reset_node.mjs
scripts.verify:recompute-node: cd .. && wasm-pack build core --target nodejs --out-dir /tmp/world_node && cd app && node scripts/verify_recompute_local_node.mjs
scripts.verify:recompute-deps-node: cd .. && wasm-pack build core --target nodejs --out-dir /tmp/world_node && cd app && node scripts/verify_recompute_dependents_node.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:core && npm run test
